plainLanguage: Outside city limits, Texas counties do not issue building permits or zoning rules for houses. State law still requires new houses to follow the IRC and to get three inspections by a licensed third-party inspector. You will usually need a county floodplain permit, a driveway permit, and a septic permit if there is no sewer. Your plat and deed restrictions set the setbacks and often require brick or a minimum house size. Fire sprinklers are not required.
